mapper.select: SELECT donation_id AS donationId, user_id AS userId, title, description, image_path AS imagePath, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, view_count AS viewCount, is_emergency AS emergency FROM donation WHERE status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
